title: Cat What? Murderous Black Cat With Knife Gift Premium Unisex Hoodie Pullover Casual Streetwear Graphic Print
description:
Custom hoodies are versatile in style and easy to match with almost any outfit. Made with heavyweight yet soft fabric, this hoodie delivers exceptional comfort, warmth, and a cozy feel for everyday wear.

Key Features:

  • Heavyweight & Soft Fabric: Designed to keep you warm, comfortable, and relaxed throughout the day.

  • Material & Fabric Details:

    • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²

    • Heather Sport Dark Navy: 60% Polyester / 40% Cotton

    • All other colors: 50% Cotton / 50% Polyester

    • Cotton blend fabric absorbs sweat well and feels soft on the skin

  • Comfort & Construction:

    • Double-lined hood with color-matched drawcord

    • Pouch pocket for convenient storage and hand warmth

  • Printing Technology: Digital printing delivers bright, vibrant colors that remain vivid after washing.

  • Available Colors: Ash, Black, Carolina Blue, Charcoal, Dark Heather, Forest Green, Gold, Heliconia, Irish Green, Light Blue, Light Pink, Maroon, Military Green, Navy, Purple, Red, Royal, Sport Grey, White, Cherry Red, Dark Chocolate, Heather Sport Dark Navy, Orange, Sand, Graphite Heather, Safety Orange, Navy Heather, Antique Cherry Red.

  • Blank Product: Primarily made using Gildan 18500 blank hoodies. If unavailable, equivalent blanks from Hanes, Jerzees, or Port & Company may be used.

Care Instructions:

  • Washing: Turn inside out before washing. Hand wash in cold water is recommended. Machine wash cold on gentle cycle if needed. Use mild detergent only. Avoid bleach or harsh chemicals. Wash dark and light colors separately.

  • Drying: Hang to air dry and avoid direct sunlight. If using a dryer, select low heat or delicate cycle to protect the print.

  • Ironing: Turn garment inside out. Use low heat and avoid ironing directly on the printed area. A pressing cloth is recommended.

Custom hoodies are versatile in style and easy to match with almost any outfit. Made with heavyweight yet soft fabric, this hoodie delivers exceptional comfort, warmth, and a cozy feel for everyday wear.

Key Features:

  • Heavyweight & Soft Fabric: Designed to keep you warm, comfortable, and relaxed throughout the day.

  • Material & Fabric Details:

    • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²

    • Heather Sport Dark Navy: 60% Polyester / 40% Cotton

    • All other colors: 50% Cotton / 50% Polyester

    • Cotton blend fabric absorbs sweat well and feels soft on the skin

  • Comfort & Construction:

    • Double-lined hood with color-matched drawcord

    • Pouch pocket for convenient storage and hand warmth

  • Printing Technology: Digital printing delivers bright, vibrant colors that remain vivid after washing.

  • Available Colors: Ash, Black, Carolina Blue, Charcoal, Dark Heather, Forest Green, Gold, Heliconia, Irish Green, Light Blue, Light Pink, Maroon, Military Green, Navy, Purple, Red, Royal, Sport Grey, White, Cherry Red, Dark Chocolate, Heather Sport Dark Navy, Orange, Sand, Graphite Heather, Safety Orange, Navy Heather, Antique Cherry Red.

  • Blank Product: Primarily made using Gildan 18500 blank hoodies. If unavailable, equivalent blanks from Hanes, Jerzees, or Port & Company may be used.

Care Instructions:

  • Washing: Turn inside out before washing. Hand wash in cold water is recommended. Machine wash cold on gentle cycle if needed. Use mild detergent only. Avoid bleach or harsh chemicals. Wash dark and light colors separately.

  • Drying: Hang to air dry and avoid direct sunlight. If using a dryer, select low heat or delicate cycle to protect the print.

  • Ironing: Turn garment inside out. Use low heat and avoid ironing directly on the printed area. A pressing cloth is recommended.

Custom hoodies are versatile in style and easy to match with almost any outfit. Made with heavyweight yet soft fabric, this hoodie delivers exceptional comfort, warmth, and a cozy feel for everyday wear.

Key Features:

  • Heavyweight & Soft Fabric: Designed to keep you warm, comfortable, and relaxed throughout the day.

  • Material & Fabric Details:

    • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²

    • Heather Sport Dark Navy: 60% Polyester / 40% Cotton

    • All other colors: 50% Cotton / 50% Polyester

    • Cotton blend fabric absorbs sweat well and feels soft on the skin

  • Comfort & Construction:

    • Double-lined hood with color-matched drawcord

    • Pouch pocket for convenient storage and hand warmth

  • Printing Technology: Digital printing delivers bright, vibrant colors that remain vivid after washing.

  • Available Colors: Ash, Black, Carolina Blue, Charcoal, Dark Heather, Forest Green, Gold, Heliconia, Irish Green, Light Blue, Light Pink, Maroon, Military Green, Navy, Purple, Red, Royal, Sport Grey, White, Cherry Red, Dark Chocolate, Heather Sport Dark Navy, Orange, Sand, Graphite Heather, Safety Orange, Navy Heather, Antique Cherry Red.

  • Blank Product: Primarily made using Gildan 18500 blank hoodies. If unavailable, equivalent blanks from Hanes, Jerzees, or Port & Company may be used.

Care Instructions:

  • Washing: Turn inside out before washing. Hand wash in cold water is recommended. Machine wash cold on gentle cycle if needed. Use mild detergent only. Avoid bleach or harsh chemicals. Wash dark and light colors separately.

  • Drying: Hang to air dry and avoid direct sunlight. If using a dryer, select low heat or delicate cycle to protect the print.

  • Ironing: Turn garment inside out. Use low heat and avoid ironing directly on the printed area. A pressing cloth is recommended.

Custom hoodies are versatile in style and easy to match with almost any outfit. Made with heavyweight yet soft fabric, this hoodie delivers exceptional comfort, warmth, and a cozy feel for everyday wear.

Key Features:

  • Heavyweight & Soft Fabric: Designed to keep you warm, comfortable, and relaxed throughout the day.

  • Material & Fabric Details:

    • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²

    • Heather Sport Dark Navy: 60% Polyester / 40% Cotton

    • All other colors: 50% Cotton / 50% Polyester

    • Cotton blend fabric absorbs sweat well and feels soft on the skin

  • Comfort & Construction:

    • Double-lined hood with color-matched drawcord

    • Pouch pocket for convenient storage and hand warmth

  • Printing Technology: Digital printing delivers bright, vibrant colors that remain vivid after washing.

  • Available Colors: Ash, Black, Carolina Blue, Charcoal, Dark Heather, Forest Green, Gold, Heliconia, Irish Green, Light Blue, Light Pink, Maroon, Military Green, Navy, Purple, Red, Royal, Sport Grey, White, Cherry Red, Dark Chocolate, Heather Sport Dark Navy, Orange, Sand, Graphite Heather, Safety Orange, Navy Heather, Antique Cherry Red.

  • Blank Product: Primarily made using Gildan 18500 blank hoodies. If unavailable, equivalent blanks from Hanes, Jerzees, or Port & Company may be used.

Care Instructions:

  • Washing: Turn inside out before washing. Hand wash in cold water is recommended. Machine wash cold on gentle cycle if needed. Use mild detergent only. Avoid bleach or harsh chemicals. Wash dark and light colors separately.

  • Drying: Hang to air dry and avoid direct sunlight. If using a dryer, select low heat or delicate cycle to protect the print.

  • Ironing: Turn garment inside out. Use low heat and avoid ironing directly on the printed area. A pressing cloth is recommended.
